title: Delete the pi-CLI worker path; prove on staging and in real local + cloud runs
description: Step 9 without the A/B: on staging kill the host mid-tool, destroy the container mid-turn, deploy mid-run; then one real cloud epic run and one local epic run on pi-durable; delete image/worker.sh's pi-CLI harness path, the pi CLI in the image and the herdr/subprocess pi-CLI profiles.
acceptance_criteria: [A2]/[A4] evidence in RESULT; make gate passes with the CLI path removed
